name: The Unyielding Winter
source:
It's a chilly blizzard kind of night. And you're at home, eating a bowl of delicious stew your grandma made for you.

Since the storm shows no signs of calming down, why don't you come and sit down by the fire? Grandma would like to tell you a story about Winter and their siblings. 

[From [url=https://cynimonogurui.itch.io/the-unyielding-winter]itch.io[/url]]
